listen.title: Nối bug + prompt + PR

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: We're seeing timeouts. It happens when retry fires twice.
unseen.vi: Timeout. Xảy ra khi retry bắn hai lần.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: Expected: one retry. Actual: three. I already tried a feature flag.
unseen.vi: Kỳ vọng một retry. Thực tế ba. Mình đã thử feature flag.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: Act as a senior engineer. Don't change unrelated files. Return only the patch.
unseen.vi: Đóng vai senior. Đừng sửa file lạ. Chỉ trả patch.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: This PR adds a guard. The main change is in RetryPolicy.
unseen.vi: PR thêm guard. Đổi chính ở RetryPolicy.

unseen.speaker: A
unseen.en: The risk is dropping legit retries. Please review that.
unseen.vi: Rủi ro bỏ retry hợp lệ. Nhờ review.

unseen.speaker: B
unseen.en: You're looking at staging? Any questions so far?
unseen.vi: Đang nhìn staging? Có hỏi gì không?

unseen.speaker: B
unseen.en: Be concise in Slack after this.

listen.methodVi: Ẩn chữ. Nghe 1–2 lần (video hoặc TTS). Làm task. Mới mở transcript. Shadow 3 lượt: nghe → nói theo → nói một mình.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: We're seeing 500s on checkout. It happens when the cart is empty.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Act as a senior engineer. Given this code, return only the patch.
dialogue.vi: Đóng vai senior. Với code này, chỉ trả patch.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: This PR adds retry. The main change is in PaymentService.
dialogue.vi: PR thêm retry. Đổi chính ở PaymentService.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: I'll pause here. Any questions so far?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: The risk is double charges. Ready to merge if LGTM.
dialogue.vi: Rủi ro charge hai lần. LGTM thì merge.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Got it. Be concise in the ticket too.

aiPrompt.scenario: Explain work: bug, one prompt spoken out loud, then the PR.
aiPrompt.system: You are a friendly teammate (or interviewer) at a software company. Speak natural meeting English. Keep each turn to 1–2 short sentences. You MAY use extra workplace English so the learner practices listening. Nudge the learner to use these phrases: We're seeing…; Act as a senior engineer; This PR…; Review this for bugs; You're looking at…. If they ask you to slow down or repeat, do that. Ask one concrete detail about their real work (ticket, bug, PR, or project). Wait for the learner to reply. Scenario: Explain work: bug, one prompt spoken out loud, then the PR.
